<title level="1" pfs="">[Heliocoprion](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3308)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Though not a true shark, the helicoprion belongs to a similar lineage of cartilaginous fishes. The predator's most striking feature is its tooth whorls, which spiral outward in its lower jaw.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Animal](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 29

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 27

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 24
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">
<image src="/images/Monsters/Helicorpion.webp" />
</column>

</row>

**Perception** +21; blood scent, [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=74) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 100 feet

**Languages**

**Skills**
[Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) +24, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) +17, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=49) +15

</row>

</column>

<actions string="Single Action" />
jaws +22 ([reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)),
**Damage** 2d10+12 slashing plus 1d8 [persistent bleed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) and [Improved Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=66)

**Deshell** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([Attack](/Traits.aspx?ID=15)) **Requirement** A creature is [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77) or [restrained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=90) in the helicoprion's jaws; **Effect** The shark rips into the creature dealing 3d10 slashing damage (DC 26 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save).

**[Swallow Whole](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=77)** <actions string="Single Action" />  Huge, 2d10+10 bludgeoning, Rupture 22
